messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike detected on /v1/generate — p95 1.2s -> 3.8s, p99 2.3s -> 9.6s, errors 5xx increased from 0.3% -> 6.4% (service: inference-gateway)

oncall-alex: I'm paged, joining. Any idea if this correlates with the 09:10 deploy?
sanjay: yep deploy rolled at 09:09 (release: inference-runtime@2026-03-15-rc5). We started seeing tail latency after ~30s.
andrea: seeing KV cache miss rates jump in the tracing UI. Many requests hitting larger context paths and causing repeated attention recompute.
lucy: routing shows traffic still hitting the new nodes in cluster-eu-west. Load looks balanced but latency per pod is high.
miguel: logs show a new kernel flag enabled in rc5: attention-opt=dynamic_kv. Could be regressing with our mixed-quant models.
oncall-alex: okay, immediate mitigation options? 1) rollback to rc4, 2) enable traffic-fallback to smaller model variant, 3) throttle long-context requests.
beth-support: support ticket volume ticking up, customers reporting timeouts in chat. Need ETA and impact statement for messages to customers.
andrea: quick check: can we toggle 'dynamic_kv' at runtime? I don't think it's hot-switchable in this build.
sanjay: confirm — flag baked into compiled runtime. Hot toggle not possible. Rollback is fastest.
oncall-alex: miguel, can you trigger rollback? We'll prepare a canary rollback and then global if green.
miguel: running: redwood deploy rollback --service inference-runtime --to-revision 2026-03-15-rc4 --strategy canary --region eu-west
infra-bot: Deploy started (id: dpl-1954012351). Canary 10% -> monitoring p95/p99 for 2min windows.
andrea: setting an emergency rule to divert new sessions >4k tokens to fallback-model-small for 10 minutes.
lucy: added route override: route: inference-gateway/* -> fallback-model-small (priority emergency).
oncall-alex: can we also enable circuit breaker to fail fast on >2s backend latency to reduce downstream cascades?
sanjay: enabled cb threshold = 2s on gateway. Will immediately cut long tail retries.
beth-support: customer impact: top 5 tenants saw 15-40% request failures. I shared a short blurb in #support-urgent with suggested copy.
miguel: canary rollback completed (id: dpl-1954012364). Canary metrics: p95 dropped from 3.7s -> 1.1s, p99 from 9.6s -> 2.2s, errors down to 0.6%.
oncall-alex: good. Proceed to full rollout rollback.
miguel: full rollback in progress -> redwood deploy rollback --service inference-runtime --to-revision 2026-03-15-rc4 --strategy immediate --regions all
infra-bot: Rollback started (id: dpl-1954012378). Estimated completion 90s.
andrea: monitoring KV miss rates returning to baseline on rc4 nodes. Cache warm-up looks good.
lucy: gateway traces show reduced retry storms now.
beth-support: support updated customers: "We've identified a deployment-related latency regression causing increased timeouts. We've rolled back the deploy and are monitoring. We will follow up with incident details."
oncall-alex: infra-bot, confirm rollback finished and leaderboards.
infra-bot: Rollback finished successfully at 1954012480. No failed nodes reported.
miguel: post-rollback metrics: p95 1.05s, p99 2.1s, errors 0.5%. Backend CPU on problematic pods normalized.
andrea: root cause initial hypothesis: attention-opt dynamic_kv interacts poorly with mixed-quant kernels, causing pathological attention recompute for long contexts. Need reproducible test.
sanjay: opened a blocker PR to revert the dynamic_kv change at build level and added a CI workload with long-context regression tests.
oncall-alex: oncall handoff in 20m. I'll prepare a short handoff note: rollback done, metrics stable, customer comms sent, follow-up postmortem assigned to eng-runtime + eng-ml.
beth-support: can we get a rough estimate of number of customer requests affected?
andrea: rough count: ~18k total requests across 10 minutes exhibiting >2s latency, ~3.2k 5xx responses.
lucy: logged a datadog dashboard snapshot and linked in this thread.
miguel: saving the deploy artifact and build logs to the incident bucket (s3://redwood-incidents/1954012345/).
oncall-alex: ok team — if nothing else, I'll hand to morning oncall in 20. Keep this channel updated if latency creeps. Postmortem owner: @sanjay, timeline and RCA due EOD tomorrow.
sanjay: ack, will coordinate with andrea + miguel for root cause and mitigation plan (QA long-context test, revert runtime flag, and add gating).
beth-support: I'll consolidate customer updates and provide identifier list for SRE to cross-check logs.
infra-bot: NOTE: Please add the label "rollback" and "sev-2" to this incident ticket (inc-1954012345).
oncall-alex: added labels. Handing off to oncall-lucy in 20.
lucy: taking over. I'll keep watches and check again in 1h.
